headline_seed: Middle East crisis live: Donald Trump cancels US envoy trip to Pakistan for ceasefire talks with Iran
description_seed: US president says ‘too much time’ has been ‘wasted on traveling’ as Israel strikes Lebanon, claiming Hezbollah also launched rockets We have some images coming through the newswires of Iran’s foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi , speaking with Pakistan’s army chief, Asim Munir, and other officials in Islamabad this morning. Araghchi arrived in Pakistan last night. He wrote on social media that his trip would focus on “bilateral matters and regional developments”. Continue reading...
